JSON_RESPONSE_MISSING
Description
Triggered when an HTTP (or HTTP/2) response has no body or does not contain JSON content.
Examples
when
JSON_RESPONSE_MISSING
{
log
local0.
"No JSON content in message response"
}
Related Information
